verdict.rationale: Pulumi's testing guide documents three test types: fast in-memory unit tests that mock all external calls, property tests, and integration tests that deploy ephemeral infrastructure. Unit tests are written in the program's own language using standard frameworks like Mocha or NUnit, so tests run without touching production. `pulumi preview` adds a no-change dry run. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the testing workflow.
